messages:
Alex (Sales): Quick sync — QuietBank wants BYO-HSM for prod inference. High level asks: HSM-backed customer master keys (CMKs), monthly automated rotation, proof of FIPS/Crypto attestation, a pre-go-live penetration test, and an SLA that keeps key unwrap latency under 30ms. Also want clarity on price delta between Hosted (with key-proxy) vs Dedicated (reserved GPUs + HSM). Who can confirm feasibility + timeline?

Tony (Solutions): We can do BYO-HSM via our key-proxy. Main tradeoffs: extra network hop for unwrap (adds ms), and we need to tune local KV cache TTLs per-customer to hit 30ms. Need to know QPS and average prompt length to size.

Priya (SE): +1. Send QPS and 95th token length distribution. We typically target a local cache hit >95% to keep unwraps rare. If they insist on no on-path network calls, Dedicated with HSM in same VPC and our proxy colocated reduces median to ~10-15ms typically.

Kate (QuietBank): We can share rough numbers: peak inference QPS ~1200 requests/s, median input ~150 tokens, 95th token length ~420 tokens. Pen-test window: they need it before pilot in 6 weeks. Also need audit logs forwarded to their SIEM.

Maria (Security): Pen-test: fine from our side, but timeline depends on scheduling third-party assessor and ticketing. We can provide an enterprise checklist: key attestation docs, KMS integration runbook, and sample audit streams. Regarding SLA: we can commit to availability and an unwrap latency SLO for Dedicated + colocated proxy, not for cross-region hosted BYO.

Alex (Sales): Ok — can we get a concrete POC timeline for the 6-week pilot target? Also want an estimated cost delta to put in the quote.

Priya (SE): POC plan (high level):
- Week 0: access + network whitelisting, exchange of JWK/KMS endpoints, cert handshake.
- Week 1: deploy key-proxy in QuietBank VPC (or our VPC peering path), run smoke tests.
- Week 2: integrate key unwrap into inference path + enable KV caching; perf tuning.
- Week 3: pen-test scheduling and dry run of audit logs.
- Week 4: pilot load ramp and SLA validation.
We can compress to 3 weeks with weekend ops support.

Priya (SE): Sample smoke-test curl (for ops):
```
curl -X POST https://proxy.example.com/unwrap \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"key_id":"projects/quietbank/keys/cm-01","ciphertext":"..."}'
```
Expect JSON response with plaintext_key (base64) and ttl_ms.

Tony (Solutions): On pricing: rough delta guidance — Hosted + key-proxy add-on: incremental network egress and per-request unwrap billing -> adds variable cost. Dedicated reserved + colocated proxy: upfront reserved footprint + fixed per-month HSM proxy fee. For quoting, I'll draft two options: a variable-metered hosted path and a committed dedicated path.

Alex (Sales): Tony — can you put ballpark numbers for the internal quote today? I just need order-of-magnitude to present to their procurement.

Tony (Solutions): I can do ballpark: Hosted BYO-proxy: +$0.01/unwrap (variable) + small monthly proxy baseline. Dedicated reserved: +$8k/month baseline for proxy + smaller per-unwrap discount. I'll convert to per-1M-requests numbers and share after lunch. (these are placeholders until finance signs off). :winking_face:

Maria (Security): Audit & compliance notes for QuietBank:
- We will enable key usage logs and forward via S3/collector to their SIEM (TLS mTLS only).
- Rotation: we support automated rewrap rotation monthly; need to confirm any dual-custody ceremony requirements.
- Attestation: we have FIPS-140-2/3 documentation and can provide HSM vendor certs.

Kate (QuietBank): Dual-custody is a must for master key rotation (internal policy). Also need end-to-end test vectors for latency validation and proof that rotations don't interrupt in-flight inference.

Priya (SE): For rotation resilience we recommend: short-lived session keys (derive ephemeral per-request) + async rewraps. That way active requests don't block on rotation. We'll provide a small test harness that simulates in-flight rotations.

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered: key-proxy-staging -> env quietbank-staging. Run id: dpl-20260314-78 (ETA ~2h).

Tony (Solutions): I'll draft a short SOW appendix for the BYO-HSM work: network diagram, expected perf numbers, proxy sizing, pen-test window, and audit log targets. Will attach to the quote.

Alex (Sales): Action items: Tony to provide ballpark pricing + SOW draft today; Priya to share perf tuning checklist and the harness; Maria to start attestation/runbook pack and note any blockers for dual-custody; QuietBank (Kate) to confirm date windows for pen-test and whether they want us in same VPC or prov. peering.

Kate (QuietBank): Pen-test window preference: weeks of May 2 or May 9. We prefer peering if possible. Will confirm by EOD.

Maria (Security): We can do May 2 for pen-test but will need the assessor vendor/company by Friday. Also will schedule the attestation handoff doc review early next week.

Alex (Sales): Thanks everyone. I'll update QuietBank with the compressed 3-week option if we can get weekend ops.

Tony (Solutions): FYI — internal note: we need to whitelist QuietBank ASN and open outbound 443 to their KMS proxy, and set cache TTL to 10s initially, tune down to 1s if stable.

Priya (SE): Link to our BYO-KMS runbook: https://redwood.example.com/docs/byo-kms-runbook (contains test harness and audit schema).

Alex (Sales): Great. Closing thread for now — will reopen if Kate confirms. :thumbsup:
